query:
-- Quais meses/anos têm faturamentos no tenant 60002
SELECT MONTH(data) as mes, YEAR(data) as ano, COUNT(*) as dias
FROM faturamentos
WHERE tenantId = 60002 AND empresaSlug = 'MASCOTE'
GROUP BY YEAR(data), MONTH(data)
ORDER BY ano, mes;

-- Meta de abril/2026 no tenant 1
SELECT mes, ano, metaMensal, metaQuinzenal, diasUteis, diasUteisQuinzenal
FROM metas
WHERE tenantId = 1 AND empresaSlug = 'MASCOTE' AND mes = 4 AND ano = 2026;

-- Faturamentos de abril/2026 no tenant 1 (Mascote)
SELECT COUNT(*) as dias_lancados, SUM(cat1+cat2+cat3+cat4+cat5) as total
FROM faturamentos
WHERE tenantId = 1 AND empresaSlug = 'MASCOTE'
  AND data >= '2026-04-01' AND data <= '2026-04-30';
